provider: meta (the machine's signed-in account, contributor mode enabled in its settings; no model call, only initialize and model/list)
commands: muse serve (child process; initialize with clientInfo muse_spark_code, then model/list, over stdio)
notes: model/list serves the same four ids with and without --contributor-mode on

no contributor-tier row is ever served; session/start accepts <base>-contributor by name for every listed base (probed 2026-10-18: muse-spark-1.3-contributor, muse-spark-1.2-contributor, muse-wonder-1.0-contributor, muse-wonder-full-1.0-contributor)
a session running on a contributor model flags no row active, scoped or unscoped
the CLI's own bundled code-review agent names model muse-wonder-full-1.0-contributor
